method: Compile all lesson Python fences, execute deny-by-default policy/projection/heuristic examples, run the host probe against the neighboring exact server code, and smoke-test tools/list in Docker with no network, read-only root, dropped capabilities and non-root UID.
limitations: The examples are deterministic demonstrations, not a security certification or proof against prompt injection.
Docker run verifies startup and tools/list only; it does not test real MCP clients, HTTP transport, provider behavior or real side effects.
The prompt-injection counts are a small DeepSeek deepseek-flash sample from 2026-10-08 and were not rerun.
